subject: Operations

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: Synchronous connection.Open()/transaction.Commit()/Rollback() calls block the thread inside an otherwise async request path
findings.recommendation: ResetTestingAsync is already async and receives a cancellationToken, but connection.Open() and transaction.Commit()/Rollback() are synchronous, blocking the calling thread while the DB round-trip completes. Use await connection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken), and cast to DbTransaction/use connection.BeginTransactionAsync(cancellationToken) so CommitAsync(cancellationToken)/RollbackAsync(cancellationToken) can be awaited too.

strengths.subject: Operations
strengths.title: DB connections rely on driver-managed connection pooling rather than an explicit anti-pattern

checkResults.subject: Operations
checkResults.reason: In-scope code (TestingRepository/TestingService/TestingController) implements a data-reset write action against a short in-memory config list (IApplicationConfiguration.DataSources), not a repeated/expensive read; no cacheable read pattern exists in this batch.

checkResults.subject: Operations
checkResults.reason: connection.Open() and transaction.Commit()/Rollback() in TestingRepository.ResetTestingAsync are synchronous blocking calls inside an async method, despite async alternatives (OpenAsync/CommitAsync/RollbackAsync) being available.

checkResults.subject: Operations
checkResults.reason: CreateConnection builds a new SqlConnection/NpgsqlConnection per call using a plain connection string with no Pooling=false override, so the driver's default connection pooling applies; a new IDbConnection object per call is the expected ADO.NET pattern and does not itself defeat pooling.

checkResults.subject: Operations
checkResults.reason: ResetTestingAsync issues a single QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync call against a fixed reset script; no loop-based per-row/per-item query pattern exists in the reviewed files.

checkResults.subject: Operations
checkResults.reason: No hot loops with repeated expensive work were found; the only iteration is a FirstOrDefault over a small in-memory DataSources list.

notes: Scope limited to Testing repository/service/controller and OpenTelemetry extensions; PERF-01 marked N/A because this batch contains only a write/reset action, not a cacheable read path.
